prompts.simple: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production UI background asset for ASIST, wide 16:9, 2048x1152. A warm off-white matte plaster wall in soft morning daylight. Large, very soft, out-of-focus shadows of leaves and a thin window frame fall diagonally across the wall from the upper right, low contrast, gently blurred edges. Subtle fine plaster texture, calm and airy, quiet Scandinavian minimalism. The overall tone stays light grey-beige (no pure white anywhere) so white UI panels with dark text placed on top remain clearly separated. No single focal point: the light and shadow spread evenly so the image still reads well when the left and right thirds and the center are covered by UI. No plants in frame, no furniture, no objects, no people, no typography, no UI, no borders.
prompts.pop: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production UI background asset for ASIST, wide 16:9, 2048x1152. Bold, joyful flat graphic pattern in a risograph print style. Large overlapping organic blobs, circles, squiggly lines, half-moons and scattered small confetti shapes in saturated candy colors (tomato red, sunny yellow, bubblegum pink, mint green, cobalt blue) on a warm cream base. Slight risograph grain and imperfect ink overlap, playful and energetic but balanced, like a modern design studio poster. Shapes are spread evenly across the whole canvas with no single focal point, so it still looks good when large parts are covered by solid white UI cards. No characters, no faces, no letters, no numbers, no typography, no UI, no borders.
prompts.cool: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production UI background asset for ASIST, wide 16:9, 2048x1152. Minimal dark brutalist interior: smooth charcoal concrete walls and black glass planes meeting at precise angles, seen in near-darkness. A single thin blade of cold white daylight enters through a narrow slit and cuts diagonally across the surfaces, with faint reflections on the glass. Almost monochrome graphite and steel grey, crisp, calm, architectural, photoreal, matte. The image is very dark overall so light UI text stays legible, and the composition has no single focal point, so it still reads well when the left and right thirds and the center are covered. No blue neon, no cyan or violet glow, no warm light, no furniture, no people, no typography, no UI, no borders.
